meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器,查看当前工作区的诊断、定义、引用、符号,并在重命名前做合法性检查、再应用改动。这些 lsp.* 是工具调用名,不是 shell 命令。
howto.when: 当你需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等能力,或要在当前工作区做重命名安全检查时触发。

say.text: 列出当前工作区里已配置和激活的语言服务器
检查这个文件的诊断,只看 error 级别
检查这个符号能否重命名,可以就执行重命名

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can call the lsp MCP tools to get language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, and rename safety checks in the workspace, then apply the rename edit. lsp.* are tool-call names, not shell commands.
howto.when_en: Use when you need language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, and similar, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

say_en.text: List the language servers configured and active in this workspace
Check this file for diagnostics, errors only
Check whether this symbol can be renamed, then rename it
